messages:
maya: Pausing the change window. CI integrationartifact upload failing with short write, deploybot stuck retrying promote.

lee: Can you paste the uploader error?

maya: From bk-agent-3 @ 07:15 UTC:
```
[artifact-uploader] wrote 131072 bytes, then write failed: short write
ERROR 2026-03-23T07:15:12Z upload aborted: short write while sending multipart chunk
```

ash: That looks like runner ephemeral disk issue during upload or a flaky network path. infra-bot, anything on runner GC?

infra-bot: ALERT: us-east-runner GC spike at 07:12 UTC, reclaimed 8 ephemeral volumes (rate x6).

joel: If we wait and re-run we might miss the change window. Do we have a last-good promoted artifact to pin?

maya: Last promoted artifact is commit 1769890000, image sha256:77b8e9c4. I propose pin+manual-promote and open infra ticket for uploader resilience.

lee: +1. I'll approve manual promote. Also flag for release notes.

deploy-bot: ACTION: manual promote requires approver; run `deploybot manual-promote --pin 1769890000 --reason "CI uploader short write"` to proceed.

maya: Running now: `deploybot manual-promote --pin 1769890000 --author @maya`

buildkite-bot: PROMOTE STARTED: canary rollout for release 2026.03.23-pin-hotfix (sha256:77b8e9c4).

deploy-bot: PROMOTE COMPLETE: canary healthy, monitoring 15m.

ash: Draft release note: "Hotfix: pinned to previously promoted artifact (sha256:77b8e9c4) after intermittent artifact uploader short-write errors in CI; infra follow-up opened (infra#4729)."

joel: Filed infra#4729: "artifact uploader short write during runner GC spike; add better chunk retry and reduce chunk size". Assigning to @infra-team.

maya: Temporarily paused aggressive GC in us-east for 25m. Keeping change window open; will call rollback if canary metrics degrade. Thanks all :thumbsup:
